messages.text:
Had a nice phone call, with Abel.  Lots of encouraging thins said.  None of them are happening.

Been waiting 3 weeks on some questions.

Yes, I have used the online chat.  It keeps telling me someone will bet with me when you open.  Has not happened.

I updated my scores on Trust Pilot, Out of good faith.  Well, now I can lower them, plus the 3 new ones I got.

Thanks for nothing.

Raland
Handed to the team · RMA approval and Abel's promised answers both need a person; order carries no rm

Hi Raland,

You are right, and I am not going to dress it up. You were told things on that call, you have asked the same questions here for three weeks, and nothing has come back to you. That is on us.

Here is where it stands today, in one place. Your BC04 on Shop···· and the three DC02s on Shop···· were written up as defective after both flash routes refused Harlo OS. You also paid for the Harlo OS Diagnostics and 3-Month RMA line on that same order, which makes the firmware our job to settle, not yours to chase. I cannot approve the replacements myself, so I have put the whole thing, the four units and the two answers Abel owes you, in front of Georges and JD as one decision rather than four threads.

The team is on now and a colleague is picking this up today. You will get the answer as a reply to this email, including what happens with the units and with the price match.

On Trustpilot, write it as you found it. I would not ask you to soften it, and I would rather fix the thing than the rating.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
